conventions.chains: cup = consecutive left triples, cap = consecutive right
conventions.coloring: vertices sorted by projection on the sweep direction; triple is left iff orientation of the three points in that order is positive
conventions.database_direction: x-coordinate with ties broken by y
conventions.decomposable: ErdosSzekeres.IsDecomposable: recursive deep-below split with interleaving allowed; crossing triple is left iff its middle vertex is in the lower part
